A '''safe house''' was operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==History==
By [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="3642BBY" /> the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]], the primary [[Spy/Legends|intelligence]] agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Strategic Information Service}}</ref> operated a safe house in a building off [[Main Production Boulevard]] in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the safe house was used as the local headquarters of SIS division head [[Ardun Kothe]]. [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Cipher Agent|Cipher]] [[Cipher Nine|Nine]] reported to the safe house after conducting a covert assault on an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]] as the first step of infiltrating the SIS.<ref name="TMS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Safe House appeared as a story area for the Imperial Agent player character class on Nar Shaddaa in Act II of the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]].<ref name="TMS" />
